slice 1: ValueStore bound to a Registry: every write validated, ChangeEvent per accepted change, no event for unchanged value, undo() with Stale refusal, reset, Interaction apply

slice 1: egui_adapter: one renderer driven only by descriptors, stable egui ids from control id, inline rejection text, soft-range marker; headless (egui 0.33.3, default_fonts only, no eframe/accesskit/wgpu)

slice 1: projection: agent_json + registry_from_json (full re-validation) + manual_topics from the same descriptors; dead-control audit Registry::audit(); DESCRIPTOR const + examples/controls-consumer

slice 2: Shift/Alt picks replaced by spec: GestureRoles (Shift coarse x10, Ctrl on Windows/Linux or Command on macOS = egui `command` fine /10, both x100, Alt unused) via roles_from(); pointer sensitivity per STU-SHL-191 frozen at press (ScrubGesture: max(q, soft_range/200) else max(q, max(|anchor|,1)/200), delta = dx - dy, accumulator clamped to hard bounds only so dragging back from a hard stop returns immediately, crosses soft bounds)

slice 2: gesture protocol in ValueStore (STU-SHL-194): Update* -> Live events (not undo steps), End -> ONE Committed event press value -> final value (single undo step; net-zero gesture emits none), Abort/Escape -> restores press value, Aborted event excluded from undo; writes during a gesture refused; label scrub and slider both gesture-aware in the egui renderer

notes.fine_step_vs_precision: Interpretation (accepted by lead pending spec enrichment): precision = declared DISPLAY decimal places; step=10^-precision, fine_step=step/10 and coarse_step=step*10 are DERIVED (STU-FX-110), fine_step may be finer than the display precision. Stored/accepted values keep full parsed precision; nothing rounds to precision silently. Step arithmetic only strips binary noise (1e-9 grid below 1e6).
notes.modifier_defaults: RESOLVED slice 2 from STU-FX-149 / STU-SHL-190 (14-studio-creative-suite.md l.19006, l.32910): coarse Shift x10, fine Ctrl (Windows/Linux) or Command (macOS) /10, both x100, Alt has no numeric role; implemented as roles_from(egui::Modifiers) using egui `command`. Slice-1 Shift/Alt pick removed.
notes.step_at_hard_bound: Spec is SILENT on an arrow/accessibility step that would leave the hard range (STU-FX-110 defines step/fine/coarse; STU-FX-110a: only pointer scrubbing clamps, typed/non-pointer values reject). Kept: such a step is REJECTED with OutOfHardBounds(Int); the pointer route is the only clamping route.

implemented_from_spec: STU-SHL-191 sensitivity (anchor and step frozen per gesture, fractional accumulation retained)
STU-SHL-192 hard clamp only, gesture continues at a hard stop (dragging back returns immediately)
STU-SHL-194 one scope per gesture, Escape restores the press value, aborted gesture excluded from undo, success = one promoted history entry
STU-FX-110 integer step=coarse=fine=1 (modifiers never skip), STU-FX-112 integer kind (signed, four bounds)
STU-SHL-165 groups from group_path + collapsed_by_default, STU-IO-109 group_path = ordered container ids
STU-SHL-193 one display string (format_value) for field and projections
spec_silent_choices: arrow/accessibility step with BOTH roles: step*100 (STU-FX-110 gives step/fine/coarse only; the x100 of STU-SHL-190 is stated for drag/wheel)
arrow/accessibility step beyond a hard bound: reject (see step_at_hard_bound)
pointer values are not quantized to step/precision (only binary noise stripped); integer scrub rounds to nearest
soft-bound resistance zone width/deceleration (STU-SHL-192 says 'short resistance zone', no numbers): NOT implemented; scrub crosses soft bounds freely
slider track = complete soft pair else complete hard pair; Escape during a slider drag aborts like label scrub
enumeration is by stable option id, not STU-FX-115/116 1-based index with separators/default_index (index mapping is an import/wire concern for a later slice)
section ids share one id space with control ids; inside a level controls render before child sections

notes.dep_requests: slice 1 lines (egui =0.33.3 default_fonts only, serde =1.0.229, serde_json =1.0.151) stay in builders/dep-requests.jsonl; slice 2 adds only the allowed path edge hsk-studio-observe (no crates.io change).
notes.serde_json_float: serde_json default float parsing is exact for <=15 significant digits (tests use such values); no float_roundtrip feature enabled.
known_gaps: wheel gesture (STU-SHL-189/194: 400 ms after the last notch finalizes) not implemented; gesture finalization on focus loss/modal open happens only via pointer release or Escape
no gesture-role rebinding configuration (STU-FX-149 allows typed rebinding with conflict validation): defaults only
no soft-bound resistance zone (STU-SHL-192), no double-click reset / secondary-click menu (STU-SHL-195), no search / show-only-non-default filters (STU-SHL-165 items 5/6)
no AccessKit projection / accesskit feature; no expression-driven read-only state (STU-MOT-072)
angle (wraps), point_2d/3d, enumeration-by-index, layer_reference, path, action, label kinds of STU-FX-112 not modelled
report() builds one Observe per call (caller supplies correlation/resource/actor); no Observe progress frames for live gesture samples
egui rendering verified headless only via value/interaction/section-visibility outcomes; no pixel/visual proof
